visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with reddish-brown hair tied in a bun and wearing black-framed glasses sits on a cream-colored sofa. She wears a beige knitted cardigan over a white dress. She is holding a smartphone with a gold case, looking at the screen with a thoughtful expression. The background features a modern indoor living room with warm wooden panels and soft lighting. (2) Suddenly, a male hand reaches into the frame from the left, grabs the smartphone, and throws it toward the floor. Digital fire-burst graphics are edited around the frame to emphasize the tension. The camera follows the woman as she stands up and walks toward a wooden corner of the room to retrieve the device. (3) She kneels down in a narrow wooden hallway and picks up the phone, showing the screen to the camera to demonstrate it is undamaged. She then transitions into a product demonstration, holding up several blue and white product boxes branded 'imos'. Screen recordings of the phone's interface are overlaid, showing a messaging app and a Pokémon mobile game to illustrate screen clarity. (4) The woman stands in the center of the room, holding a product box toward the camera. She smiles brightly and gestures with her hands while speaking. The lighting remains bright and consistent throughout the scene. The video ends with a close-up of her face as she reaches her hand out toward the lens to take back the phone.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a loud, aggressive male voice shouting in Mandarin, exhibiting high arousal and fast speech, complaining about filming duration. A faint, high-tempo electronic beat starts in the background. (2) A sharp 'thud' sound occurs as the phone hits the floor, followed by a surprised and defensive female vocal response. The male voice continues to shout with heavy vocal tension. (3) The BGM transitions into a bright, upbeat electronic pop track with a strong 4/4 beat. The female voice shifts to a professional, friendly narrative tone, explaining the technical features of the screen protector with clear articulation. (4) Digital 'pop' and 'whoosh' sound effects are used frequently as screen recording overlays appear. The female speaker maintains a high-pitched, enthusiastic energy while describing blue light filtration. (5) The music swells slightly for the conclusion as the female voice invites the audience to use a discount code. A final percussive 'catch' sound marks the end of the video as she reaches for the phone.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Conflict -> Resolution/Introduction -> Detailed Proof -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote imos screen protectors by first creating a dramatic hook involving a phone being thrown to prove durability, then detailing the technological benefits of blue light protection and offering a discount code.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of product boxes, technical feature explanation with branded graphics, and the provision of a personal discount code 'YUCI'.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses a high-energy comedy skit to grab attention before transitioning into a standard social-media marketing format.
